parent_models.justification: Both llm2vec and doc2vec are embeddings-based models, where the core idea is to represent inputs as dense vectors. doc2vec typically refers to document embeddings, while llm2vec refers to language model embeddings.

Both llm2vec and data2vec are concerned with converting data into meaningful embeddings. While data2vec is more general, it involves a similar fundamental principle of embedding data, aligning with the concept of llm2vec for language models.

closest_parent_model.justification: doc2vec is the closest semantically to llm2vec as both focus on embedding representations specifically derived from textual data, whereas data2vec is broader in its scope.

closest_child_model.justification: There are no models in the Given List that are direct specializations or specific adaptations of llm2vec.

sibling_models.justification: As a method involving data embedding, data2vec shares a broader parent category with llm2vec.

closest_sibling_model.justification: Among the Sibling Models, data2vec is closest to llm2vec because both focus on embedding data into vector spaces, though in different domains or data types.
